description: The Plan screen as rows: each plan with what every bill does to it (out of net, part of the split, or ignored) and its buckets — what each is for (a goal, a debt, a category, a fund, an account or nothing) and how it is sized. Ids are here for `set_plan`, `set_fixed_expense_roles` and `edit_fixed_expenses`. The worked-out figures for a month are `plan_month`.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.

plan_id.description: One plan. Default: all of them.
